notes.title: The Violinist [UPDATE 1.1]
notes.content:
[h1]Hi, BigBenDev here,[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980673/d3bf51a04aedac4dddd180f2018f91db1306db78.png[/img]

[h2]I'm glad to announce the first update of "The Violinist".
I've listened to your feedback and addressed several issues and added new features in this 1.1 patch.[/h2]

•  Fixed. Tuning score no longer adds to the final score.
•  Fixed. W, A, S, D keys could not be bound.
•  The bow screw was tightening in the wrong direction.
•  Scene optimization (improved performance).
•  Added sounds for tap and hold notes (this option can be toggled in the options menu).
•  Added "latency compensation" option (Audio/Video Offset).
•  Improved note accuracy for the following songs: Beethoven virus, Eine kleine nachtmusik, Hungarian Dance, String quintet N5, The Nutcracker Act 1: March (difficulty changed from 6 to 5), Spring Mv 2, Summer Mv 3, Winter Mv 1, Winter Mv 3.
•  The tuning button in the tuning minigame now deactivates when pressed correctly or incorrectly (previously it could be continuously pressed).
•  You now earn approximately 50 more coins when tuning.
•  Tuning minigame optimization.
•  More detailed earnings UI.

notes.title: Fixed Bugs and Improve UI

notes.title: The Violinist Launch Delayed Due to Technical Difficulties
notes.content:
I am writing to inform you of an unfortunate delay in the release of "The Violinist." I've encountered unforeseen technical difficulties that have prevented us from delivering the quality experience we had envisioned for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980673/be149ea39537abd0e678bc16d56f3e404d445b58.png[/img]

I understand that delays can be frustrating, and I want to sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. As a solo developer, I'm committed to ensuring that "The Violinist" meets the high standards I've set for myself and for the community. To achieve this, I have made the difficult decision to postpone the launch, I'll be releasing "The Violinist" as soon as possible.

You can continue playing the demo version as usual to help you decide whether to purchase the full game.

Your patience and understanding are greatly appreciated. Thank you for your continued support.

BigBenDev
